known.summary: `parseUpgradeEvent` checks only the plugin id against SAFE_TOKEN, not the `before` and `after` versions. The versions come from the installed plugin inventory, so the author of a plugin chooses them, and `upgradeReminder` puts each one word for word into the `additionalContext` of every main omp session. A plugin version with text such as an instruction to the agent so goes into the model context as a kit reminder (CWE-74, prompt injection). The pull request adds pluginUpgrades.ts: the base has no such file and no upgrade reminder.
